Tapu Koko

Electric Fairy

Alola · Generation 7 · Legendary Pokémon

Tapu Koko is an Electric/Fairy-type Land Spirit Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 20.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (130), with a base stat total of 570.
